text:
The story in Toronto isn't Auston Matthews's scoring. It's a team that lost nine straight before beating the Islanders on Nov. 23, and a captain quoted in a Times of India headline saying "We should be embarrassed". The headlines turned straight to his future: Elliotte Friedman's line, as The Hockey Beast reported it, was "All bets are off", while an insider quoted by Sportskeeda said he'd be shocked by an in-season trade.

Through it all Matthews has 34 points in 26 games and 13.2 expected goals on his own shots, among the most dangerous shooters in the league. Our wins-added measure has him fifth of 567 skaters. The odd part is his on-ice luck: Toronto has scored 11.8 more goals than the chances deserve with him on the ice, so his totals are padded even as the team sinks around him. His last ten games brought ten points, a bit under expectation. Our numbers project about 41 goals and 92 points. What to watch is whether the losing changes his role before it changes his address.
headline: Matthews produces while the Leafs fall apart
